audience_problem: A fictional adult follows two ribbons back to one source card and replaces a vague instruction with a sourced question.

packaging.title: The Two Ribbons on His Source Card
packaging.promise: Two ribbons make the relationship between a short note and its source tangible.

sources.claim: Atomy USA’s registration guide says a sponsor is needed and supports automatic or manual designation.
